title: The Output Convergence Debate Revisited: Lessons from recent developments in the analysis of panel data models
abstract: arXiv:2602.04060v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper provides a critical examination of the empirical basis of the output convergence debate in the light of recent developments in the analysis of dynamic heterogeneous panels with interactive effects. It shows that popular tools such as Barro's cross-country regressions and two-way fixed effects (TWFE) estimators that assume parallel trends and homogeneous dynamics lead to substantial under-estimation of the speed of convergence and misleading inference. Instead, dynamic common correlated effects (DCCE) estimators due to Chudik and Pesaran (2015a) provide consistent estimates and valid inference that are robust to nonparallel trends and correlated heterogeneity and apply even if there are breaks, trends and/or unit roots in the latent technology factor. translated_title: 产出收敛之争再审视：来自面板数据分析最新进展的启示
translated_abstract: 本文结合具有交互效应的动态异质性面板数据分析的最新进展，对产出收敛之争的实证基础进行了批判性审视。研究表明，诸如Barro跨国回归和假设平行趋势与同质动态的双向固定效应（TWFE）估计量等流行工具，会导致对收敛速度的大幅低估并产生误导性推断。相比之下，Chudik和Pesaran（2015a）提出的动态共同相关效应（DCCE）估计量能够提供一致的估计和有效的推断，对非平行趋势和相关性异质性具有稳健性，即使潜在技术因子存在结构突变、趋势和/或单位根时也依然适用。本文还提出了一种估计缓慢变动的增长决定因素影响的方法。理论发现辅以基于宾夕法尼亚世界表数据的实证证据。
tldr: 本文批判性审视产出收敛之争的实证基础，指出Barro跨国回归和TWFE估计量因假设平行趋势和同质动态而严重低估收敛速度并导致误导性推断，而动态共同相关效应（DCCE）估计量能对非平行趋势和相关性异质性提供稳健一致的估计与有效推断。
en_tdlr: This paper critically re-examines the empirical basis of the output convergence debate, showing that Barro's cross-country regressions and TWFE estimators substantially under-estimate convergence speeds due to assumptions of parallel trends and homogeneous dynamics, while dynamic common correlated effects (DCCE) estimators provide consistent estimates and valid inference robust to nonparallel trends and correlated heterogeneity.
